# Notifications & messaging blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Notifications & messaging blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## notifications

In-app notifications sent through a security definer notify(): one event per change, per-recipient read, dismissed and resolved state, per-channel deliveries, subject subscriptions, preferences with a tenant override, and realtime on a private topic.

- Title: Notifications
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/notifications
- Client: `notificationsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/notifications`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `updated-at`
- Works with: `permissions`, `profiles`, `memberships`, `data-lifecycle`, `consents`, `housekeeping`
- Events (`NotificationsEvents`): `notification.bounced`, `notification.clicked`, `notification.complained`, `notification.created`, `notification.delayed`, `notification.delivered`, `notification.opened`
- Provides: `notifier`

## chat-sdk-state

The Chat SDK StateAdapter in Postgres for better-supabase/chat-sdk: thread subscriptions, token locks, a TTL cache, capped lists and per-thread queues under a key prefix, plus the bot installations per workspace with a credential_ref instead of the token. Service role only.

- Title: Chat SDK state
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/inbox
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `housekeeping`
- Works with: `housekeeping`

## inbox

Conversations with contacts across the in-app widget and chat channels, on the messaging core: inboxes, members and teams, contacts who are people of the contacts block, messages and internal notes with scanned files, mentions, assignment, bot hand-off, read state, delivery status, stored webhook events, message templates, scheduled replies and reply drafts, including ai drafts staff review. Staff read with inbox.read; contacts read their own conversations without the notes; Realtime pings carry ids only.

- Title: Shared inbox
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/inbox
- Client: `inboxBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/inbox`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `updated-at`, `teams`, `messaging`, `attachments`, `contacts`
- Works with: `queue`, `notifications`, `reactions`, `data-lifecycle`, `automations`, `tasks`, `tags`
- Entities: `inbox`
- Tables: `inboxes`
- Permission keys: `inbox.read`, `inbox.reply`, `inbox.assign`, `inbox.manage`
- Events (`InboxEvents`): `inbox_conversation.assigned`, `inbox_conversation.opened`, `inbox_conversation.reopened`, `inbox_conversation.resolved`, `inbox_conversation.unsnoozed`, `inbox_message.received`

## push

The push tokens of each user's devices (Expo, FCM, APNs or Web Push) with RLS, behind register_push_device and unregister_push_device for the user and push_tokens_for and prune_push_tokens for the service role. With notifications, push_tickets keeps Expo's tickets per delivery for the receipt check. better-supabase/blocks/push registers Expo devices and sends through the Expo Push API.

- Title: Push devices
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/push
- Client: `pushBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/push`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Works with: `notifications`
- Events (`PushEvents`): `push.device_registered`, `push.device_unregistered`
